description: This Dart file defines the 'AppTheme' class which provides a static method to generate a custom light theme for a Flutter application. The theme customizes various UI components including colors, text styles, navigation bar, card, input decorations, chips, and buttons.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A class that provides static methods for creating application themes, specifically a light theme for the app.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Builds and returns a ThemeData object configured with custom colors, styles, and component themes for a light-themed UI.
